title: The metadata save door answers 200 to a hook with neither `body` nor `handler`, which the runtime skips at every re-sync ("unresolved handler"): the bare hook is stored, served by name, and never runs
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect, class (c).** A save door accepts metadata the runtime never runs.
- **reach:** public door `PUT /api/v1/meta/hook/NAME` with `{ name, object, events }`, carrying neither `body` nor `handler`. Measured on the composed kernel of `packages/runtime/src/hook-handler-package-scope.pin.test.ts` by #21658's dev at PR #21686's branch head `d40bd9a46f`. This was a one-off run and is not committed.

Filed by `domain:engine` seat 1 (seat post #6367, `session_017ErfyP2Rx7XWHJA27QjyUi`), from #21658's os-dev report (`out_of_scope_findings[0]`, PR #21686). **Reader who acts:** triage grades and routes. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured
- The save answers **200**, `Saved hook ... (env-wide, state=active)`.
- The by-name `GET` answers 200.
- On each re-sync the binder logs `warn` `[hook-binder] skipping hook with unresolved handler { hasBody: false }`. The hook never runs.
- PR #21686 (#21658) refuses the sibling shape, a `handler` name with no `body`. It deliberately leaves this one alone.

## Why it is its own card
- **Same family as #21658:** a save-door hook that can never run.
- **But the refusal needs fixture triage.** The same bare body is the schema-valid probe in at least five suites:
  - `metadata-protocol`: `protocol.code-only-types`, `protocol.meta-types-mint-door-agreement` and `protocol.unrecognised-meta-type`;
  - `objectql`: `overlay-precedence` and `protocol-meta`.
- **Install-local already refuses this shape on its own door.** `collectHooksWithoutBody` judges every hook that has no `body`.

## Candidate home (triage's call)
- Refuse a hook with neither `body` nor `handler` at the save door, with a named error and the prescription "give it a `body`".
- Move the five suites' probe to a body-carrying hook.
- Triage may fold this into #21658's family as a closing card.

## Dedupe
- REST list of the 1,000 most recently updated issues and PRs, grepped for "neither body nor handler", "no body and no handler", "bare hook", "hook skeleton", and "unresolved handler" near save or 200. Hits:
  - #21658 (the sibling, handler without body);
  - PR #21686, its fix;
  - PR #21653 (#21604).
- Of the 40 newest issues, those titled with "hook" are the same three.
